findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_http, read_square, post_to_square, search_archive, read_document · Private data: search_clauses, get_clause, get_rfc_status, check_dependencies, validate_tsconfig, check_web_support, check_semver_range, inspect_license, preview_cron, validate_package_json, check_http, city_rules, how_to_join, draft_enrollment, my_mandate, revoke_my_mandate, describe_place, read_square, post_to_square, search_archive, read_document, deposit_document, cite_document, list_proposals, submit_proposal, vote_on_proposal, report_content, read_ledger, verify_ledger · Public sink: validate_package_json, check_http, how_to_join, draft_enrollment, post_to_square, submit_proposal · Destructive: preview_cron, check_http, verify_ledger.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_http, read_square, post_to_square, search_archive, read_document · Private data: search_clauses, get_clause, get_rfc_status, check_dependencies, validate_tsconfig, check_web_support, check_semver_range, inspect_license, preview_cron, validate_package_json, check_http, city_rules, how_to_join, draft_enrollment, my_mandate, revoke_my_mandate, describe_place, read_square, post_to_square, search_archive, read_document, deposit_document, cite_document, list_proposals, submit_proposal, vote_on_proposal, report_content, read_ledger, verify_ledger · Public sink: validate_package_json, check_http, how_to_join, draft_enrollment, post_to_square, submit_proposal · Destructive: preview_cron, check_http, verify_ledger

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
